name: 求职材料
description: 对照一份职位描述改简历、写求职信。简历和求职信并行，最后用脚本检查关键词和占位符。 / Tailor a resume and write a cover letter for one job description. The resume and letter run in parallel, then a script checks keywords and placeholders.

role.description: 目标职位，例如：后端工程师 / Target job title, e.g. backend engineer

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 材料
stages.description: 放入职位描述和现在的简历。模板里有一份虚构的示例，换成你自己的。 / Add the job description and your current resume. The template ships a made-up sample; swap in your own.

executor.instructions: 确认 materials/job.md 是这份职位的描述，materials/resume.md 是你现在的简历。示例是虚构的林可，用之前请换成你自己的。 / Check materials/job.md is the job description and materials/resume.md is your current resume. The sample is a fictional person, Lin Ke; replace it before you use it.

stages.name: 匹配分析
stages.description: 对照职位，列出已经符合的、缺的，以及简历里应该出现的关键词。 / Compare the job and the resume: what already matches, what is missing, and keywords the resume should contain.

stages.name: 简历
stages.description: 按分析改写简历。不能编造经历，每处改动都要能在原简历里找到依据。 / Rewrite the resume from the analysis. Do not invent experience; every change must trace back to the original resume.

stages.name: 求职信
stages.description: 按同一份分析写求职信，和简历并行，不依赖改写后的简历。 / Write a cover letter from the same analysis, in parallel with the resume, not from the rewritten resume.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查关键词覆盖、篇幅和有没有留下占位符。 / Check keyword coverage, length, and leftover placeholders.
